_comment: Issue #1628: a deep, narrow Infantry column (frontage_override 3 -- 3 files x many ranks) is ordered on a short straight diagonal march centred on its closest approach to the default map's hill block (Battle.TERRAIN rect (1150,380)-(1400,580)) -- a true perpendicular gap of ~226wu, comfortably outside this column's fixed, frontage-based terrain_clearance() (~22.5wu: 0.5*(3-1)*file_pitch_wu()+soldier_body_radius()) but well inside its OLD pivot-radius-based clearance (~356wu, which folded in the column's own depth). Before the fix, PathField read this straight leg as blocked by terrain hundreds of world units away and swung the column ~240wu off its line; after it, the march holds dead straight the whole way. drill mode (no enemy needed -- this demonstrates pathing, not combat). `state` samples every 4 ticks from 8 through 840 (fixed_fps 30 x max_frames 420 in demo.1628.json's own manifest = 840 covered physics ticks, per website/tools/dump-demo-states.sh's tick_count formula: max_frames*60/fixed_fps) so the defect scan and the per-tick PR transcript see the WHOLE march, not just its first quarter -- the unit actually arrives (MOVING -> IDLE) at tick 748, so this range covers spawn through arrival plus a settling margin. Every single tick (833 samples) was measured to blow the CI transcript comment past GitHub's 65536-character limit by 3x (201164 chars); every 2 ticks (417 samples) still overshoots it (100762 chars); every 4 ticks (this file's 209 samples) is the finest step that stays comfortably under it (51820 bytes, run through tools/ci/state-transcript-summary.sh's own jq filter against a real dump of this scenario) while still sampling at 15 Hz -- far finer than a player (or the demo-defect scan) needs to catch a transient.
